name: Paul Fall
occupation: Former Sheridan County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; The Sheridan Press reported that he retired at the beginning of 2026)
prior_offices: Sheridan County assessor (won the November 2022 general election; retired at the beginning of 2026)
background: Paul Fall served as Sheridan County assessor after winning the November 2022 general election. The Sheridan Press reported on January 21, 2026, that he retired at the beginning of the year and that the county commission appointed Koko Knudtson to finish the term.

sources.name: The Sheridan Press, Jan. 21, 2026, Knudtson appointed as assessor
